name: Ray-Occlusion Traversal in Octree
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for an octree structure that handles rays starting inside or outside the root voxel. It computes entry points by intersecting the ray with the root bounding box planes and traverses the octree hierarchy to find the first non-empty leaf or surface.
summary: Ray-Occlusion Traversal in Octree is a hierarchical ray-intersection algorithm that explicitly handles rays starting inside or outside the root bounding box via plane intersection logic and fixed-depth descent loops.
